description:
Instant Clusters supports long-lived, resizable in-DC shared storage with user data persistence.
You can dynamically create and attach volumes to your cluster at cluster creation time, and resize as your data grows.
All shared storage is backed by multi-NIC bare metal paths, ensuring high-throughput and low-latency performance for shared storage.

is_lifecycle_independent.description: When true, the shared volume is not deleted when the cluster is decommissioned.

project_id.description: Project ID that will own the volume. When omitted, the caller's default project is used.

region.description: Region name. Usable regions can be found from `clusters.list_regions()`

volume_name.description: User provided name of the volume.

size_tib.description: Size of the volume in TiB.

status.description: Current status of the shared volume.

volume_name.description: User provided name of the volume.
